title: Tanzania Is Quietly Building the Infrastructure of a Different Future
standfirst: Fresh financing for the Tabora–Kigoma SGR, the TAZARA revival and plans for a southern Mtwara–Mbamba Bay corridor show a country trying to turn geography into economic power. The opportunity is enormous—but infrastructure ambition must be matched by accountable institutions and political openness.
seo_title: Tanzania’s Railways, Vision 2050 and a New Regional Economic Map
seo_description: Waithaka Ndegwa examines Tanzania’s newly financed Tabora–Kigoma SGR, TAZARA revival, southern railway plans, Vision 2050 and the governance challenge.
